title: Code review agent with a maintainer gate
summary: Plans a review of a pull request, reviews files in parallel and posts comments only after a maintainer approves.

components.role: split the pull request into review tasks
components.name: Review planner

components.role: review one file or one concern and propose comments
components.name: File reviewer

components.role: read the diff and surrounding files
components.name: Repository reader

components.role: post review comments on the pull request
components.name: Pull request commenter

components.role: a maintainer approves the comments before they are posted
components.name: Comment approval

guardrails.description: A token and file-count cap per pull request stops runaway fan-out.
Every posted comment is logged with the plan step that produced it.

failure_modes.description: The plan skips the risky files.
Reviewers post many low-value or wrong comments.
The planner spawns far more review tasks than the change needs.

threats.note: code and comments under review can carry instructions
write access to the pull request

eval_plan.method: maintainers label a sample of proposed comments
pull requests with known injected defects

deployment.runtime: worker triggered by pull request events
deployment.notes: Comments are held in a queue until approved.
